findings.summary: Holding Logger.mu during Formatter.Format serializes formatting across goroutines, and a custom Formatter calling a locking Logger method (e.g. SetLevel) would now deadlock.

judge.reason: Identifies that holding Logger.mu during Format can deadlock when user code in a formatter calls back into the logger's locking methods, which is the same cause as b1; it also notes the known serialization cost.
